allow: PowerShell(foreach \($u in "http://localhost:8081/bankAccounts","http://localhost:8081/","http://localhost:8081/h2-console"\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $u -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; "$u -> $\($r.StatusCode\) : " + $r.Content.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(300,$r.Content.Length\)\) } catch { "$u -> ERREUR : $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })
